fields.title: UHMWPE creep
fields.finding: SK99/DM20 exceed1%creep over30days at900MPa/30C; thin strength-sized films are more highly stressed and warmer.
fields.proposed_fix: Obtain stress/temperature/time creep and rupture data for actual laminate; do not apply a single900MPa rate to higher stresses.

claim: SK99/DM20 exceed1%creep over30days at900MPa/30C; thin strength-sized films are more highly stressed and warmer. | UHMWPE creep
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
